warnings: THIS IS NOT A ZINC FERTILIZER STUDY - this paper studies nitrogen fertilizer effects on Zn accumulation
The study uses ZnSO4·7H2O but applies it to ALL treatments equally (30 kg/ha) - there is no Zn fertilizer treatment vs control comparison
All treatments receive the same zinc fertilization due to low soil DTPA-extractable Zn
The treatments are different N rates (N0, N1, N2, N3), not Zn application rates
This paper does not fit the meta-analysis inclusion criteria as it does not test Zn fertilizer application effects
